verdict.rationale: Docs show domains auto-renew by default at registry list price, with a per-domain Auto-Renew status that can be reviewed and disabled, and the expiration date visible in the dashboard. That covers the auto-renew-control half of the story. Community reports of duplicate renewal charges and a renewal not reflected in the expiration date suggest renewal surprises do occur, which lowers confidence but does not contradict the documented controls. Missing for 10: expiry/renewal notification emails, documented grace and redemption windows after lapse, and independent corroboration of reliable renewal behavior.
